title: Oil predicts stock returns (Driesprong, Jacobsen and Maat 2008, JFE): equity timing by lagged crude return
rule: at each month end, s = sign of the CL roll-safe return over the past L trading days (lagged, known at the close); equity position for the next month on ES/NQ/RTY/YM (0.25 each): LS = -s (long after oil fell, short after it rose); LO = long only when s < 0, else flat
judgement: current 14-sleeve book + entrant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.102
